items.name: Stripes iris
items.description: Wavy mint and purple stripes open in an 8-petal flower-shaped iris, cover the frame, then close.

items.name: Bloom wave
items.description: A blue flower bloom sweeps in from the left behind a wavy edge and wipes out the same way.

items.name: Grid tiles
items.description: A 3×3 flower grid builds tile by tile along a diagonal, then the tiles shrink away.

items.name: Pink stripes blinds
items.description: The stripes hue-shifted to pink and orange, closing and opening as staggered horizontal blinds (1.6s version).

items.name: Warm bloom iris
items.description: An orange and pink bloom inside a 6-petal iris.

items.name: Stripes and bloom diagonal
items.description: The bloom keyed over the stripes, wiping across on a diagonal.

items.name: Rings wave
items.description: Wavy concentric rings in the stripes palette, wiping right to left with a wavy edge.

items.name: Violet grid tiles
items.description: A violet flower grid whose tiles pop in and out in random order.
